title: Final Check · Weeks 9–12
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1. My brother, ___ lives in Dubai, is an engineer.
2. That's the student ___ father is a doctor.
3. This is the café ___ we used to study.
4. I'm used to ___ (get) up early.
5. It took me a month to get used ___ my new job.
6. I ___ smoke, but I gave up three years ago.
7. You're Egyptian, ___?
8. Could you tell me where the station ___?
9. It was ___ a hot day that we stayed inside.
10. ___ it was raining, we went out.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1. أنا معتاد على المشي كل يوم.
2. هل يمكنك أن تخبرني متى يغادر القطار؟
3. أخي، الذي يعيش في ألمانيا، طبيب.
4. أُلغيت الرحلة بسبب العاصفة.
5. ستتعوّد على العمل الجديد قريبًا.
answers: 1. I'm used to walking every day.
2. Could you tell me when the train leaves? / Could you tell me what time the train leaves?
3. My brother, who lives in Germany, is a doctor.
4. The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
5. You'll soon get used to the new job. / You'll get used to the new job soon.

sections.title: C. Write the Arabic meaning (5 marks)
items: 1. scholarship = __________
2. prescription = __________
5. fall behind = __________

sections.title: D. Speaking check — tick what you can do
items: ☐ I can talk about my education and add extra information with who, which and whose.
☐ I can talk about my habits now and in the past (used to / be used to / get used to).
☐ I can solve travel problems and ask polite questions.
☐ I can give my opinion about the future and link my ideas (although, however, because of).

score: My score: ______ / 20   18–20 Excellent · 16–17 Very good · under 16: repeat the sentences of these weeks for 3 days, then try again.
